'''Smeer Ze-Trios''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who worked for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="BFN" /> During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]</ref> Ze-Trios worked as a [[Settlement Warden]] for the Federation, overseeing [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camps on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He was considered to be brutal.<ref name="Twitter" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Smeer Ze-Trios was voiced by [[Roger Jackson]] in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
